steps.html:
Have you visited Brazil before? — Yes, twice.

I came here when I was a child.

steps.title: Present Perfect or Past Simple?
steps.html:
Present PerfectPast Simple
Use it forexperience, no time saida finished time
ExampleI've been to Brazil.I went there in 2019.
Signal wordsever, never, before, already, yetyesterday, last year, in 2019, ago, when I was…
QuestionHave you ever been…?When did you go?
TogetherI've been twice. I came here as a child.

A conversation often starts in the Present Perfect and then moves to the Past Simple for the details.

As soon as a time word appears — last summer, in 2019, three years ago — you need the Past Simple.

Learners often write I've been there last year. With last year it has to be I went.

steps.title: Look at the pairs.
examples: I've visited Brazil twice. — I came here when I was a child.
She's run a marathon. — She ran a marathon last April.
I've watched it twice this month. — I watched it twice last month.
I've never left a film early. — A few months ago I went to see a terrible one.
Have you ever been to Rio? — No, I've never been here before.

steps.title: Write a summary of your year.
steps.sub: Six sentences: what you did, what you have done for the first time, and what you are going to do next.
steps.html:
• This year I …
  • I've … for the first time.
  • I've never …
  • In March I …
  • Next year I'm going to …
  • I hope to …
I'veI haven'tI wentI wasI'm going tofor the first timeneverlast yearnext yearbecause
steps.modelHtml:
• I used the Past Simple with a time word
  • I used the Present Perfect with no time word
  • I used going to for a plan

steps.prompt: What is the second sentence describing?
options: Something that was happening around another action
steps.answer: Something that was happening around another action
steps.why: That is the Past Continuous. You only need to recognise it for now — Pre-Intermediate teaches you to use it.
steps.html:
I came here when I was a child. — you know this one

It was raining when I arrived. — this one is new
